about_text:
The *Sabian General Hospital IT Support* department keeps our hospital's technology running around the clock. We manage computers, medical record systems (EMR/EHR), networks, email accounts, and all peripheral devices so our clinical and administrative staff can focus on patient care. Our helpdesk is available 24/7 to assist with any IT issue.

Please submit a support ticket through this bot and our engineers will get back to you as soon as possible.
services: 🌐 *Network & Connectivity* — Wi-Fi, VPN, and LAN issues
📧 *Email & Account Issues* — password resets and mailbox access
🏥 *EMR/EHR System Support* — electronic medical records systems
🖨️ *Printer & Peripheral Issues* — printers, scanners, and accessories
contact_address: IT Helpdesk, Sabian General Hospital, Dire Dawa City
